build_FrozenInTime_model: build a FrozenInTime model with SpaceTimeTransformer video backbone and RoBERTa text encoder for video-language tasks
run_FrozenInTime_forward: run the FrozenInTime forward pass on video data through unfused transformer blocks with positional embeddings
compute_text_embeddings: compute text embeddings from input tokens using the RoBERTa text model in FrozenInTime
compute_video_embeddings: compute video embeddings from input video data using the SpaceTimeTransformer video model in FrozenInTime
calculate_similarity_matrix: calculate cosine similarity matrix between two sets of normalized feature vectors using sim_matrix
